description.blurb: S/2007 S 5 is a natural satellite of Saturn, belonging to the Norse group. It was discovered in 2007 and announced in 2023.
description.more: S/2007 S 5 is about 4 kilometers in diameter and orbits Saturn at an average distance of 15.8 million km in 746.88 days. It has an inclination of 158.4° to the ecliptic in a retrograde direction with an eccentricity of 0.104.
